rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=4, n_iter=18, grad_clip=1.0, unet_c=16, lr=0.00015, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1080, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=dual_domain_n2i iter-6 (search-20260619-01, PER-IMAGE Noise2Inverse: warm-start pre-pass + per-scan Adam fit; NEVER amortized). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, measured from iter-3/4/5 observations). (1) n_iter TRAJECTORY at anchored lr=3e-4, pretrain_epochs=4: iter-3 (n_iter=15) SSIM 0.9185, hr 0.1506, PSNR 35.50; iter-4 (n_iter=18) SSIM 0.9277, hr 0.19761 (BEST), PSNR 35.99, RMSE 7.934e-4, elapsed 1235.5s; iter-5 (n_iter=20, outer_wall 1150) SSIM 0.9169, hr 0.15949, PSNR 35.59, RMSE 8.310e-4 -- REGRESSED below iter-4. (2) LIMITER: hr is NOT monotone in n_iter -- it rose 15->18 then FELL 18->20. iter-5 falsifier TRIGGERED: n_iter past 18 OVERFITS each per-scan U-Net fit (PSNR fell 35.99->35.59, RMSE rose), exactly the confirmed campaign-wide insight that the per-scan U-Net N2I OVERFITS each scan and raising n_iter HURTS. n_iter is now MAPPED with an interior peak at 18. The confirmed correctly-signed lever for the overfit regime is per-scan lr-DOWN (anchor nearer the FBP-quality warm-start init): mayo-n2i 1e-3->3e-4 gave 0.9508->0.9541; lr has NEVER been pushed below 3e-4 in this campaign. (3) ONE KNOB: REVERT to iter-4 BEST (n_iter=18, the mapped peak) then drop per-scan lr 3e-4 -> 1.5e-4 (pretrain_epochs=4, n_iter=18, grad_clip=1.0, unet_c=16, val_n=214, seed=42, outer_wall_s=1080, warm_start=True ALL HELD at iter-4 -> iter-4 is the clean isolated comparison). n_iter NOT raised (at its mapped peak 18); warm_start stays True (settled-positive); unet_c stays 16 (settled-flat). lr-down is the one confirmed, correctly-signed, in-budget, untried-at-this-floor lever. (4) HYPOTHESIS: lr 3e-4->1.5e-4 at the n_iter=18 peak anchors each per-scan fit nearer the FBP-consistent warm-start init, reducing per-step overfit drift, lifting hr above iter-4 0.19761 (PSNR above 35.99). FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.19761 (no PSNR gain over 35.99), lr=3e-4 is already at/below the per-scan lr floor and per-image U-Net N2I ceilings at hr~0.20 on dense 2304-view Mayo (half-view info loss bound) -> document the ceiling (NAF/ram structural-negative class), no further per-scan tuning. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min, val=ALL 214): lr does NOT change per-step cost; n_iter=18 == iter-4 (elapsed 1235.5s measured). Fit loop 214x18x0.2557=985s + overhead ~267s = ~1252s figure-inclusive, well under the 1800s/30-min SLURM wall. Per-scene 4.60s < per_scene_s=1080/214=5.05s -> NO truncation, outer_wall_s stays 1080 (iter-4 value, NOT iter-5 1150). grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). val_n=214 NOT reduced (protocol). 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted / per-sample-ps / bg_target=truth hard-wired. PER-IMAGE structure UNCHANGED (warm-start pre-pass + per-scan fit; NEVER amortized). (6) no control return.
